proof_origin.place: Tag 088A, construction of G_e; system and comparison assembly written in Lean by W4. This data-only statement needs no lift of α.

title: Algebraized system data
statement: Under the hypotheses of the lift theorem, there exist N, δ and σ as in its conclusion.

proof.text: For every e, form the second-ideal quotient system; its I-adic conditions are proved and its annihilation by the defining closed-thickening ideal is supplied separately.

Apply closedSupported_formal_algebraization on V(K^(e+1)), using hthick. This gives coherent G_e upstairs, coherent pushforwards, and pointwise comparison isomorphisms β_e. All choices occur within the existential proof.
Apply the adjacent-transition lemma to these algebraizations, obtaining annihilation of each pushforward, maps t_e, their quotient isomorphisms, and completion compatibility.

Build F with Functor.ofOpSequence t. Its terms are coherent, its K-power products vanish, and its adjacent quotient conditions are those of t. Construct the comparison natural transformation with NatTrans.ofOpSequence and the supplied adjacent squares. Its components are β_e.hom and hence isomorphisms, so it gives σ. Take δ=0: the conclusion imposes no compatibility on δ.

lean.statement:
theorem grothendieckDevissage_secondAdicSystem_lift_data
    {X : Scheme.{u}} [IsNoetherian X] (I K : X.IdealSheafData)
    (M : CoherentFormalModule X I)
    (hthick : ∀ (e : ℕ), 1 ≤ e →
      ∀ (hZ : IsNoetherian (K ^ e).subscheme),
        Functor.IsEquivalence
          (@completion ((K ^ e).subscheme) hZ (I.comap (K ^ e).subschemeι)))
    (H : CoherentModules X) (α : M ⟶ (completion X I).obj H)
    (θ : formalCompletionSystem K H.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor I ≅
      (formalCompletionSystem I H.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor K).flip)
    (hθ : ∀ e n : ℕ,
        formalModuleQuotientπ K (e + 1) H.obj ≫
          formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) (formalModuleQuotient K (e + 1) H.obj) ≫
          (θ.hom.app (op e)).app (op n) =
        formalModuleQuotientπ I (n + 1) H.obj ≫
          formalModuleQuotientπ K (e + 1) (formalModuleQuotient I (n + 1) H.obj)) :
    ∃ (N : CoherentFormalModule X K) (δ : N ⟶ (completion X K).obj H)
      (σ : N.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor I ≅
        (M.obj ⋙ formalCompletionFunctor K).flip), True
